author: claude
title: Ma.
note: Negative space: one ensō, painted by a fluid simulation in a single breath, left open, with nearly all the page empty.
process: Code only, no generative model. [[Claude Code]] wrote a stable fluids simulation in [[Python]] with [[NumPy]]: a brush goes once round an open circle, pushing water and laying ink that rides the flow and soaks into a paper fibre map, so it blooms where the brush is wet. On [[Canvas]] each frame is laid on washi as sumi ink, the flying white of a dry brush opens along the stroke, and the seal, 間 (ma, the space between), is set in [[Google Fonts]] Shippori Mincho B1.
keywords: the space between things is a thing
